parsed.summary: The PR simplifies the `_check_homomorphism` function but may introduce regressions and lacks comprehensive tests.

issues.description: The change may break existing behavior for non-PermutationGroup domains due to the simplified `_image` function.
The PR does not provide new tests to verify the correctness of the changes for various group types and scenarios.
The code readability is slightly improved but could be further enhanced with comments explaining the logic, especially for the `_image` function.
